items.title: Document the Mechanism Placement Proof architecture and execution plan
items.context: Define the exact pre-story contract, lifecycle placement, artifact schemas, gates, freshness, story-allocation stop behavior, rollout, tests, and the B-3783 worked example. Explicitly separate candidate intake proof from PLAN verificationIntent and REVIEW/TEST/DONE evidence.

happy.desc: Inspect pre-story Mechanism Placement Proof architecture document -> contract, lifecycle placement, artifact schemas, gate definitions, freshness rules, stop behavior, rollout steps, test definitions, and B-3783 worked example are fully documented; WHY: Ensures complete pre-story proof specification.

edge.desc: Check boundary handling between pre-story intake proof vs PLAN verificationIntent and REVIEW/TEST/DONE phase evidence -> intake proof artifact remains strictly separated from post-allocation phase verification evidence; WHY: Prevents lifecycle stage confusion and evidence leakage.

adversarial.desc: Simulate missing or unverified pre-story proof artifact during story allocation attempt -> story allocation fails closed with explicit stop behavior; WHY: Guarantees Proof-or-Stop enforcement when mandatory proof is missing or invalid.

items.userSees: 用户打开 pre-story-mechanism-placement-proof-execution-plan.md，能直接看到机制定义、三种 verdict、story_create 前 no-ID gate、B-3783 示例、实施波次和测试矩阵。

items.title: Run independent Claude CLI and agy CLI architecture audits and reconcile findings
items.context: Each CLI must independently review the complete draft for duplication, authority boundaries, bypasses, fail-closed behavior, freshness, process-fact registration, rollout safety, and test completeness. Incorporate accepted findings and record dispositions in the document.

happy.desc: Execute independent Claude CLI and agy CLI architecture audits against draft document -> both CLI audits evaluate duplication, authority boundaries, bypasses, fail-closed behavior, freshness, process-fact registration, rollout safety, and test completeness; WHY: Verifies multi-agent architectural review.

edge.desc: Reconcile conflicting audit findings between Claude CLI and agy CLI -> all accepted findings are incorporated into the document with clear disposition records for rejected findings; WHY: Ensures complete reconciliation and audit trail integrity.

adversarial.desc: Attempt to finalize architecture document with un-reconciled CLI audit findings or missing disposition records -> document verification fails validation; WHY: Prevents bypassing independent audit reconciliation controls.

items.userSees: 用户在同一方案文档的审计记录中看到 Claude CLI 与 agy CLI 的版本、独立 verdict、findings、逐项处置和最终无未解决 blocker/high 的确认。
